name: Demons Ring
source:
Crawley, the king of Jeremiah was destroyed by demon king Salone. Now that his son Dumrin is of age, he sets off to avenge his father. 

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
埃雷米亚国王克劳利被魔王萨隆杀害，王国也随之覆灭。多年后，他的儿子迪姆林已经长大成人，于是踏上为父报仇的旅程。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
